games.title: Rule Shift
games.short_description: Judge shapes against a changing rule, build a streak, and react before the 60-second timer expires.
games.description: Rule Shift is a fast cognitive-switching game built for short replayable sessions. Decide whether each shape matches the current color, form or size rule while the rule changes as your streak grows. The 60-second format creates clean score, accuracy, replay and share signals.

games.title: Vector Drift
games.short_description: Nudge a drifting puck with directional impulses, collect targets, and avoid hazards for 45 seconds.
games.description: Vector Drift is a momentum arcade game where every input changes velocity rather than position. Bend a drifting puck through cyan targets, preserve combos, and avoid red hazards during a 45-second run. It tests a distinct physics-control loop against the portfolio's tap, logic and timing games.

games.title: Orbit Align
games.short_description: Rotate three orbital rings and align every cyan marker with its amber target across 20 levels.
games.description: Orbit Align is a compact visual logic puzzle with twenty levels. Rotate outer, middle and inner rings until all three markers align with their targets, then continue through progressively varied starting positions. It provides a slower level-based puzzle benchmark for replay, progression and share behavior.
